Alessandro Colace is a Forward Deployed Engineer based in Milan, Italy, and the founder of [COalesCE](__CONSULTING_URL__), an independent one-person technology consultancy. His work sits at the intersection of AI platform engineering, field deployment, and strategic advisory — translating enterprise AI technology into measurable business outcomes for organizations undergoing AI transformation.

COalesCE applies the Forward Deployed Engineer delivery model to companies that normally cannot buy it: no hand-offs, because the person who writes the roadmap is the person who builds. Services span Data Foundations (data engineering, cloud data platforms, reporting), AI in production (AI adoption audits, AI platform deployment including Palantir AIP and Foundry, Agentic AI automation), Software Rescue and legacy modernisation, Cybersecurity for SMEs, custom web and mobile applications, Fractional CTO/CDO/CIO governance, and technical training. Vendor-neutral across BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake and Palantir.

## Current Role

- **Title:** Forward Deployed Engineer — Founder, COalesCE (coalesce.coach)
- **Company:** COalesCE — independent one-person technology consultancy (data, AI, cloud, legacy, security, governance, training)
- **Location:** Milan, Italy
- **Focus:** Palantir AIP, Palantir Foundry, enterprise AI deployment, AI Ontology design, Mission Engineering, Mission Execution

## Career Timeline

### Forward Deployed Engineer — COalesCE (2022–Present)
Founded COalesCE and leads Palantir AIP and Foundry deployments for enterprise clients. Drives enterprise AI transformations by deploying AI platforms, designing AI Ontologies, and executing Mission Engineering workflows. Responsible for materializing tangible value for data-intensive enterprises across multiple industries, from Italian SMEs to large groups.

### Operations Manager — Zenkis (2020–2022)
Led the operational turnaround of a Ukrainian footwear manufacturer. Applied Lean principles and data-driven optimization to transform production cycles, restoring profitability while navigating high-stakes strategic execution. Managed plant operations, supply chain, and cross-functional teams across a full business restructuring.

### SWE & Big Data Architect — Data Consulting (2008–2009, 2013–2019)
Evolved from technical hacker roots into a strategic consultant and team leader in data consulting. Worked at leading Italian data consultancies including Data Reply, Go Reply, The Information LAB, Nimbus Intelligence, and Iconsulting. Delivered enterprise engagements for major Italian clients including Unipol, Yoox Net-a-Porter (YNAP), Telepass, Generali, Ferragamo, and IEO (Istituto Europeo di Oncologia). Orchestrated multi-million euro business development and managed large data engineering teams, while architecting end-to-end platforms from core software engineering to industrial-scale big data architectures on GCP, AWS, and Azure.
